description: Telecomunicaciones en Asturias is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Principado de Asturias. Data relating to telecommunications in Asturias: communication service lines, ICT equipment in homes, internet use, etc. NOTE: HTML provides access to a form in which, after performing a search, we can view the information in different ways and download it in PC-Axis, XLSX and CSV formats. Coverage: Principado de Asturias. The portal shows the English title as "Telecommunications in Asturias" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Principado de Asturias. Its keywords include Equipo informático, SADEI, Material de telecomunicaciones, Telecomunicación. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
